output.reason: The only evidence is a single changelog line, listed under Enhancements [ev-bfb9c0ed4d28]. It says the http-wasm host was upgraded to v0.6.0 "to support clients using v0.4.0". That describes added support, not a change to how existing plugins behave. Nothing in it says whether plugins built against earlier http-wasm guest versions keep working, work differently or break, so there is no basis for "behavior-change" or for the claim that the change "maintains compatibility". The details of PR #10475 or the http-wasm v0.6.0 release notes on host/guest compatibility are needed to pick between none, behavior-change and workload-failure.
